prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: picorv32-fetch-misalign
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): e7cb2dbaab380694
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Trace fails with FAIL 0xdead and TRAP: fetch misalign addr low bits nonzero. mem_la_addr on line 382 drives low bits as 2'b10 instead of expected 2'b00, so every lookaside fetch/data address is misaligned by 2. Root cause is the {addr[31:2],2'b10} concatenation for both next_pc and reg_op1 paths in the excerpt.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash e7cb2dbaab380694 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
